shell.portableTitle: Configuration and data live in the program folder
shell.nonPortableTitle: Data lives in the system user folder

error.title: Could not load
error.body: Could not read the Toolbox state. Try again, or check that the host is running.

tools.title: Tools
tools.subtitle: Manage installed tools, or install a new third-party tool from a local zip.
tools.emptyBody: Install an official or third-party tool from the tool market below.

permissions.title: Number of permissions you granted one by one during install

market.title: Tool market
market.introBody: Official tools ship with Toolbox (in {{dir}}); third-party tools are installed from a local zip. Check that the source is trustworthy before installing.

install.pick: Install a third-party tool from zip…
install.pickHint: Pick a local .zip package; it shows up under Installed when done

review.noPermissions: This tool requests no extra permissions
review.upgrade: “{{name}}” is already installed. Continuing overwrites the current version; the old one is backed up to data/backups/tools/.
review.title: Install “{{name}}”
review.note: Only ticked permissions are granted to the tool; unticked ones are refused by the bridge at runtime. Install tools from trusted sources only.

hotkeys.subtitle: Click a key combination to record it. Global shortcuts are shared by every tool window.
hotkeys.emptyBody: Toolbox registers the default shortcuts when it starts.
hotkeys.note: Global shortcuts may not fire while an elevated window or an exclusive full-screen game is in the foreground. If a conflict is reported, pick another combination or close the program that holds it.

record.startTitle: Click to record a new shortcut
record.cancelTitle: Esc to cancel, Enter to confirm

quickMenu.title: Hover quick menu
quickMenu.subtitle: Quick icons that fan out when you hover the ball: along the screen edge when docked, around the ball when it floats.
quickMenu.enableHint: Hover the floating ball to fan your frequent tools out along the screen edge
quickMenu.countHint: Maximum icons fanned out per direction
quickMenu.ringsHint: With two rings the icons split into an inner and an outer circle, which suits a larger icon count
quickMenu.ballAria: Hover to fan out the quick icons; drag to move it (the icons hide while dragging)
quickMenu.ballFoot: Hover the ball to fan the icons out; moving onto an icon keeps them open; dragging hides them.
quickMenu.draggingHint: Release to dock, the icons stay hidden
quickMenu.assignHint: Positions map to the fan slots in order; unassigned slots fill automatically with enabled tools ({{count}} enabled now)

slot.clear: Clear this position (falls back to auto)
slot.pick: Pick a tool; empty positions fill automatically in enabled-tool order

settings.subtitle: Adjust how Toolbox looks, the hover quick menu, startup behaviour and where data lives.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Interface colours and where the floating ball sits.

theme.title: Theme
theme.hint: Light and dark share one set of design tokens

language.title: Language
language.hint: The language used for interface text

ballDock.title: Ball docking
ballDock.hint: Where the floating ball sits on the screen edge

ballY.title: Ball vertical position
ballY.hint: 0% is the top of the screen, 100% the bottom

startup.title: Startup
startup.subtitle: Control whether Toolbox starts with Windows and how it uses the tray.
startup.autostartHint: Launch Toolbox automatically after you sign in
startup.tray: Minimize to tray when the main window closes
startup.trayHint: Keep running in the background after the window closes

data.title: Data
data.subtitle: Where configuration and tool data live. In portable mode everything stays in the program folder.
data.dirHint: Configuration, logs and third-party tools are stored here
data.portableHint: Delete the data/ folder to reset everything
data.maintenanceHint: Open the runtime logs or export the current configuration

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.subtitle: These actions affect how Toolbox runs. Use them with care.

settings.foot: Changes are written to the config file immediately; some appearance options will arrive in a later version.

about.desc: A lightweight collection of desktop tools. The image, file and system utilities you use every day live in one window, one hover of the floating ball or one global shortcut away.
about.portableNote: Portable mode: configuration, logs and third-party tools all stay in the program folder; nothing is written to your user profile.
about.nonPortableNote: Not portable: configuration and data live in your system user folder — back them up before uninstalling.
about.foot: All data lives in the program folder; deleting data/ resets everything.

modal.uninstallMessage: The tool folder will be deleted, along with any data it saved. This cannot be undone.

toast.loadFailed: Could not load, try again later
toast.copyEmpty: Path is empty, nothing to copy
toast.copyFailed: Could not copy, select the path manually
toast.minimizeUnavailable: This host offers no minimize command
toast.slotFull: Not enough enabled tools to fill this position
